title: State of the art 2025-2026 in 3D face reconstruction

queue.claim: FLAME licensing: FLAME 2020 is non-commercial research-only, and a 'FLAME 2023 Open' release exists under CC BY 4.0. This decides whether FLAME can be the shippable default prior and topology.
queue.query: FLAME 2023 Open head model license CC BY 4.0 commercial use

queue.claim: Pixel3DMM (Giebenhain et al., 2025): fine-tuned DINO ViTs predict normals and FLAME UV coordinates, FLAME is optimised to them, and it reports >15% better geometry than baselines on posed expressions on a NeRSemble-based benchmark. Code is public; venue and licence unknown.
queue.query: Pixel3DMM versatile screen-space priors single-image 3D face reconstruction posed expressions benchmark github license

queue.claim: As of late 2026, the best open few-shot photo-to-3D head methods are Pixel3DMM/MICA plus multi-view FLAME optimisation for geometry, and LAM/Avat3r/CAP4D/FaceLift for avatars. No CVPR, SIGGRAPH or ECCV 2026 method was reviewed.
queue.query: CVPR 2026 few-shot 3D head reconstruction FLAME from photos geometry accuracy

queue.claim: NoW non-metrical test leaderboard: DECA 1.09/1.38 mm, MICA 0.90/1.11 mm, best entries (for example TokenFace) about 0.75-0.8 median and 0.95 mean (median/mean, mm).
